facts.fact: A report by Momentum ITSMA found that 84% of marketers experienced pipeline growth from their ABM efforts.
facts.quote: A report by [Momentum ITSMA](https://momentumitsma.com/momentum-itsmas-annual-abm-benchmarking-study-shows-no-signs-of-slow-down-for-account-based-marketing/) found that 84% of marketers experienced pipeline growth

facts.fact: A Momentum ITSMA report found that 77% of marketers reported revenue growth from their ABM efforts.
A Momentum ITSMA report found that 72% of marketers cited a higher ROI than other types of marketing thanks to their ABM efforts.
facts.quote: 72% cited a higher ROI than other types of marketing thanks to their ABM efforts

facts.fact: Closing a B2B sale can take one to five months, sometimes up to a year or longer, according to the Databox source cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: Closing a B2B sale can take [one to five months](https://databox.com/b2b-sales-cycle-length) (sometimes up to a year, if not longer).
